name: Baird
source:
Baird is a werewolf of many talents. He's not only the alpha of his pack but a proud business owner as well. He credits all his success to the fact that he has two very distinct personalities, his levelheaded humanoid self and his brutal, aggressive wolf self. Yet another impressive quality is that Baird can swap between his forms at will. The only problem with that is the fact that it's a bit of a challenge to convince the wolf side of him to switch back.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43343]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
